title: DeerRidge Lodge Charming Retreat Historic Franklin
description:
Nestled in the serene woods, escape and discover the beauty of Franklin in this 3-bedroom lodge with lower level lounge and game room.  Our charming lodge cabin blends rustic charm w/modern comforts, featuring warm wood interiors, wood burning fireplace, 3 decks perfect for outdoor entertaining, relaxing in the swing, reading in the chaise lounge, and stargazing in the evenings.  The back deck offers picnic table seating, fire pit, rocking chairs, and BBQ for the grill master in the group.

The space
Three luxurious bedrooms, each featuring premium mattresses, high-end bedding, and a Smart TV for your comfort and entertainment. Enjoy spa-inspired bathrooms stocked with thoughtful amenities, including shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and lotion. You’ll also find hotel-quality towels, makeup towels, and blow dryers, ensuring a relaxing and convenient stay from start to finish.

Enjoy our private chauffeur service to restaurants and attractions in Franklin, Leipers Fork, and surrounding areas with advance reservation.

We are pet friendly with a $100 pet fee at booking.

Guest access
Entire home is accessible.

Other things to note
House Rules

* Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. Please be respectful of our neighborhood,  and keep noise to a minimum during these hours.

* No large gatherings, parties, or events are permitted unless prior approval has been arranged with the host.

* Please treat the property with care and respect so all guests can enjoy a relaxing and comfortable experience.
